evidence: Receiving DO2 online sensor: 11.76 mg/L at 48.0h, then 6.69/6.89/6.80/6.84 mg/L at 48.2-48.8h and 6.2-6.9 mg/L sustained through 52.0h — abrupt step drop at ~48h, unlike source-1/2/3 which read ~10.8-11.4 mg/L at the same age
Receiving delayed P assay: 3.113 g/L at t=48h (available 52h), consistent with source batches (2.98-3.06 g/L), so production is on track and stop would forfeit ~250+ kg of counted product
Forward model KEEP: product 251.8 kg, predicted post-decision minimum DO 2.34 mg/L (sensitivity range 1.41-2.43) — marginal vs the 2.0 mg/L operating minimum
Forward model combined: product 314.8 kg, minimum DO 2.45 mg/L (range 1.76-4.06), 4/5 sensitivity members feasible — highest predicted mass with adequate DO margin
Forward model reduce_feed: 280.9 kg at min DO 2.77; increase_air: 269.7 kg at min DO 2.16 — inferior mass/DO trade-off vs combined
args.rationale: At decision time 52h, product is tracking the source batches (P=3.11 g/L at 48h), but the receiving vessel shows an abrupt DO2 step-down from ~11.8 to ~6.4 mg/L at t≈48.2h — a departure from all three source batches (10-11 mg/L at that age) and an inferred reduction in oxygen-transfer capacity (model-estimated multiplier 0.59). DO2 has stabilized at ~6.4-6.9 mg/L, above the 2.0 mg/L minimum, but the source-calibrated forward model projects continued decay toward the limit under KEEP (predicted minimum 2.34 mg/L, sensitivity members as low as 1.41 — violation risk). The combined action (feed ×0.8, aeration ×1.15) both restores DO headroom (predicted minimum 2.45 mg/L) and yields the highest predicted terminal product mass (~315 kg vs ~252 kg for KEEP), retaining full volume (no mass lost). Stop is rejected because it yields zero counted production. Reduce_feed alone or increase_air alone improves only one margin; combined is the bounded intervention that addresses both oxygen supply and demand while retaining product mass.
args.uncertainty: The forward model is nominal and source-calibrated, not the hidden receiving realization; its DO floor and mass predictions carry wide sensitivity ranges (e.g., KEEP min DO 1.41-2.43; combined 1.76-4.06), so benefit magnitudes are approximate. Observed DO2 has plateaued rather than continuing to fall, so the trajectory under KEEP might not decay as the model projects; however, even the model's own sensitivity members under KEEP dip near/below 2.0, so the combined action is a prudent risk-reduction with predicted upside rather than a mandatory correction. No further assay was requested because the latest P assay (48h, available 52h) already confirms production is on track and the 4h turnaround would not materially change the oxygen-margin decision.
